description: A lab-local severity/cvss mismatch fixture: severity says high but the CVSS score 9.8 is in the critical band (9.0-10.0).
impact: An unauthenticated attacker could administer the lab instance.
proof_of_concept: GET /admin returns 200 without credentials; admin actions succeed.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the admin panel loading in the lab browser
title: Lab admin panel exposed without authentication
